question: In 2025, which Union Minister inaugurated the Khelo India multipurpose hall in Kamle district, Arunachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mansukh Mandaviya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mansukh Mandaviya**, the Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare, is known for his active participation in various infrastructural and welfare projects, including those related to sports and healthcare.
 
• In **2025**, Mansukh Mandaviya inaugurated the **Khelo India Multipurpose Hall** in the **Kamle district** of Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• The **Khelo India Multipurpose Hall** is a state-of-the-art facility aimed at promoting sports infrastructure and providing training opportunities for athletes in remote regions like Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• This initiative aligns with the objectives of the **Khelo India Programme**, which seeks to strengthen the grassroots sports ecosystem in India through the development of infrastructure and identification of young talent.
 
• The inauguration of this facility underscores the government's focus on promoting **sports culture** in the northeastern states, which are rich in sporting talent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Programme:**

 
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in **2018**, the programme aims to develop a robust sports culture in India.
 
• It focuses on **identifying and nurturing sporting talent** at the grassroots level, with an emphasis on providing world-class infrastructure and financial support to athletes.
 
• The programme includes initiatives like the **Khelo India Youth Games** and **Khelo India University Games**, which provide platforms for young athletes to showcase their talent.
 
 
 
• **Mansukh Mandaviya:**
 
 
• Mansukh Mandaviya is a senior leader in the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and has served as the Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare since **2021**.
 
• He has been actively involved in various public welfare initiatives, including healthcare reforms and the development of rural and tribal areas.
 
• His contributions to the Khelo India initiative reflect his commitment to leveraging sports as a tool for youth development and national progress.
 
 
 
• **Sports Infrastructure in Arunachal Pradesh:**
 
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is a northeastern state with immense potential in sports, given its youth population and natural athleticism.
 
• The government has been investing heavily in building sports facilities in the region, including the **Khelo India Multipurpose Hall**, to nurture local talent.
 
• Such initiatives aim to integrate the region into the national sports ecosystem and provide a platform for athletes from remote areas to compete at the national and international levels.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Multipurpose Sports Halls:**
 
 
• Multipurpose sports halls are designed to accommodate various sports under one roof, including basketball, badminton, volleyball, and indoor athletics.
 
• These facilities are crucial for regions with limited infrastructure, as they maximize resource utilization and provide training opportunities for multiple disciplines.
 
• They also serve as community centers, promoting fitness and well-being among the general population.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Union Government's Focus on the Northeast:**

 
 
• The Indian government has been emphasizing infrastructure development in the northeastern region to integrate it with the rest of the country and harness its potential.
 
• Programs like **Khelo India** are pivotal in addressing the infrastructural gaps in sports and empowering local athletes.
 
• By developing facilities like the **Khelo India Multipurpose Hall**, the government aims to create an inclusive ecosystem that promotes sports as a career option in the region.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Sports Development:**
 
 
• Sports development initiatives contribute to the **physical and mental well-being** of citizens, especially the youth.
 
• They also foster **social cohesion**, community engagement, and national pride.
 
• Investments in sports infrastructure have long-term benefits, including talent identification, economic development through sports tourism, and better representation in international events.
